name: Rain
rule: No dry marks this week, and every growing bed advances one extra stage.

name: Dry spell
rule: If you don't Tend this week, no beds grow.

name: Fog
rule: Mixed Woods is closed this week.

name: Market day
rule: Every sale is worth +1 coin this week.

name: Windfall
rule: A Log lands in your shed.

name: Cold snap
rule: Only Enoki, Frost Oyster and Tent beds grow.

name: Good season
rule: Your basket holds 1 more this week.
